newsitem.title: USA: Multimedia Games to raise working capital.
newsitem.headline: Multimedia Games to raise working capital.

text.p: Multimedia Games Inc said Thursday it had signed an agreement with Walsh Manning Securities Inc to accelerate the payment of notes and exercise warrants to yield $2.7 million of additional working capital.

Investment banking firm Walsh Manning will exercise 250,000 warrants at $8 per share, and major shareholders of Walsh Manning will pay $690,000 to Multimedia for a note which was due in August 1997, the company said.

The warrants are part of 2.042 million warrants which were exercisable at $8 per share on or after August 12, 1997 when originally issued and could be called by the company for $0.10 per share after August 12, 1997 if the common stock maintained a price of $12 per share for 20 consecutive trading days.

In consideration for the accelerated payments, Multimedia said it will extend the earliest date at which 523,000 of such warrants held by Walsh Manning can be called from August 12, 1997 until February 7, 1999.
The $2.7 million in additional capital will be used primarily to build MB-2000 player stations, the company said.
